name: Sepulchrine-Bastion

civilization.name: The Ossuarine Choirs
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: A killed landscape, vacuum-scoured and silent. The regolith holds bootprints beautifully; there are some near petrified remnants of a former biosphere that no expedition has ever claimed.
With no air to speak of, silence is total, broken only by whatever touches your boots. The horizon stays razor-sharp at any distance.
Nothing about the spatial rift remnant appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
